checks.decodedNativeAndContactProofs: Six actual decoded checkpoints per format, including intro, Those/same verse, instrumental-case focus, late chorus, final held word and empty outro. Native representative frames and both contact sheets inspected.
checks.picture: Original album art and fixed sleeve transform remain present; no shaking or missing picture.
checks.typography: Equal font size and stable RU/EN positions; complete phrase focus and refined individual focus; no visible clipping in selected proofs.
checks.metadata: Artist/title/footer letter spacing and opacity match the native-browser-adopted export implementation.
checks.animation: Shared deterministic ribbon geometry with complete source clock; sampled shapes vary with the supplied measured features and decay at the ending.

scope: Sampled visual inspection plus every-frame encoded focus/artwork and media checks. Listening approval is the separate recorded human attestation; no absolute claim of perceptual perfection.
